sections.label: A
sections.title: Match the words to the pictures.
sections.note: Use the original picture labels a, b, and c.

questions.prompt: 1. land
questions.explanation: Picture b shows an area of land with trees and grass.

questions.prompt: 2. landfill
questions.explanation: Picture c shows a landfill where trash is taken.

questions.prompt: 3. smoke
questions.explanation: Picture a shows smoke coming from a chimney.

sections.label: B
sections.title: Complete the sentences.
sections.note: Use: land, reduce, resources, reuse, sunlight, trash, wood. One word is extra.

questions.prompt: 1. Please throw that bad apple in the ___.
questions.explanation: Trash is waste that should be thrown away.

questions.prompt: 2. I made the fire with ___.
questions.explanation: Wood can be burned to make a fire.

questions.prompt: 3. It is important to protect our ___.
questions.explanation: Natural resources are valuable materials that people need and use.

questions.prompt: 4. We need to ___ the amount of trash in our park.
questions.explanation: Reduce means make the amount smaller.

questions.prompt: 5. There's ___ on sunny days.
questions.explanation: Sunlight is the light that comes from the sun.

questions.prompt: 6. I always ___ plastic bags and bottles.
questions.explanation: Reuse means use an item again instead of throwing it away.

sections.label: C
sections.title: Listen and check the correct picture. Write the word.
sections.note: Each number has two answers: choose picture a or b, then write the word.

parts.label: Correct picture
parts.explanation: Picture a shows the family at a camp.

parts.label: Write the word
parts.explanation: The word in the audio is camp.

parts.label: Correct picture
parts.explanation: Picture b shows a person surfing.

parts.label: Write the word
parts.explanation: The word in the audio is surf.

questions.prompt: 1. The bird is ___ the house.
questions.explanation: The bird is flying higher than the house, so it is above the house.

questions.prompt: 2. The library is ___ the park.
questions.explanation: The library and the park are on opposite sides, so the library is across from the park.

questions.prompt: 3. The squirrel is ___ the box.
questions.explanation: Most of the squirrel is hidden by the box, so it is behind the box.

questions.prompt: 4. The rabbit is ___ the tree.
questions.explanation: The rabbit is closer to the viewer than the tree, so it is in front of the tree.

sections.label: E
sections.title: Write the words in the correct order to make sentences. Then match them to the pictures.
sections.note: Each number has two answers: the complete sentence and the original picture label.

questions.prompt: 1. tree / dog / The / in front of / is / the

parts.label: Complete sentence
answers: The dog is in front of the tree.
The dog is in front of the tree
parts.explanation: Use subject + is + position phrase: The dog is in front of the tree.

parts.label: Picture label
parts.explanation: Picture b shows the dog in front of the tree.

questions.prompt: 2. cat / The / between / is / chairs / the

parts.label: Complete sentence
answers: The cat is between the chairs.
The cat is between the chairs
parts.explanation: Use between for something in the middle of two objects: The cat is between the chairs.

parts.label: Picture label
parts.explanation: Picture a shows the cat between two chairs.

questions.prompt: 3. tree / is / The / dog / the / behind

parts.label: Complete sentence
answers: The dog is behind the tree.
The dog is behind the tree
parts.explanation: The correct word order is: The dog is behind the tree.

parts.label: Picture label
parts.explanation: Picture c shows the dog behind the tree.

questions.prompt: 4. chairs / the / cat / The / next to / is

parts.label: Complete sentence
answers: The cat is next to the chairs.
The cat is next to the chairs
parts.explanation: The correct word order is: The cat is next to the chairs.

parts.label: Picture label
parts.explanation: Picture d shows the cat next to the chairs.

sections.label: F
sections.title: Look and circle the correct words.
sections.note: Choose the time shown on each clock.

questions.prompt: 1. Choose the correct time.
questions.explanation: The clock shows 9:00, which is nine o'clock.

questions.prompt: 2. Choose the correct time.
questions.explanation: The clock shows 3:15, which is three-fifteen.

questions.prompt: 3. Choose the correct time.
questions.explanation: The clock shows 5:45, which is five forty-five.

sections.label: G
sections.title: Circle the correct words.
sections.note: Choose the word or phrase that makes each sentence correct.

questions.prompt: 1. I can blow / surf a bubble.
questions.explanation: We blow a bubble by pushing air into it.

questions.prompt: 2. I saw a fireman recycle / rescue a cat from a tree!
questions.explanation: Rescue means save someone or something from danger.

questions.prompt: 3. I need to buy paper / a shelf at the stationery store.
questions.explanation: A stationery store sells paper and other writing supplies.

questions.prompt: 4. I saw a huge recycling plant / machine in the factory.
questions.explanation: A factory contains machines; a recycling plant is a whole facility, not one object inside a factory.

sections.label: H
sections.title: Complete the words. Then match.
sections.note: Each number has two answers: complete the word, then choose picture a, b, or c.

questions.prompt: 1. Please buy a c _ r t _ n of milk.

parts.label: Complete the word
parts.explanation: Adding a and o completes carton.

parts.label: Picture label
parts.explanation: Picture c shows a carton of milk.

questions.prompt: 2. I write my feelings in my d _ a r _.

parts.label: Complete the word
parts.explanation: Adding i and y completes diary.

parts.label: Picture label
parts.explanation: Picture a shows a diary.

questions.prompt: 3. Please put the books on the s h _ l f.

parts.label: Complete the word
parts.explanation: Adding e completes shelf.

parts.label: Picture label
parts.explanation: Picture b shows a shelf.

sections.label: I
sections.title: Write the words in the correct order to make questions. Then listen and write the answers.
sections.note: Each number has two answers: the complete question and the answer from the audio.

questions.prompt: 1. a landfill / across from / Is / the town / there

parts.label: Complete question
answers: Is there a landfill across from the town?
Is there a landfill across from the town
parts.explanation: A there is question uses Is there + noun + place phrase.

parts.label: Answer from the audio
parts.explanation: The answer in the audio is: Yes, there is.

questions.prompt: 2. books / are / Where / my

parts.label: Complete question
parts.explanation: A question about location uses Where + are + noun: Where are my books?

parts.label: Answer from the audio
parts.explanation: The answer in the audio is: They're behind your desk.

sections.label: J
sections.title: Write the questions. Look at the pictures and answer the questions.
sections.note: Each number has two answers: the complete question and a complete answer.

questions.prompt: 1. the / between / table / Is / chairs / the

parts.label: Complete question
answers: Is the table between the chairs?
Is the table between the chairs
parts.explanation: Put the words in question order: Is the table between the chairs?

parts.label: Complete answer
parts.explanation: The table is between the chairs, so answer: Yes, it is.

questions.prompt: 2. a cat / behind / there / the couch / Is

parts.label: Complete question
answers: Is there a cat behind the couch?
Is there a cat behind the couch
parts.explanation: Use Is there + noun + position phrase: Is there a cat behind the couch?

parts.label: Complete answer
parts.explanation: The cat is on the couch, not behind it, so answer: No, there isn't.

questions.prompt: 3. are / girls / Where / the

parts.label: Complete question
parts.explanation: Use Where + are + noun: Where are the girls?

parts.label: Complete answer
answers: They're in front of the library.
They're in front of the library
They are in front of the library.
They are in front of the library
parts.explanation: The girls are standing in front of the library. The answer key also accepts at the library.

questions.prompt: 4. above / the recycling plant / Is / smoke / there

parts.label: Complete question
answers: Is there smoke above the recycling plant?
Is there smoke above the recycling plant
parts.explanation: Put the words in question order: Is there smoke above the recycling plant?

parts.label: Complete answer
parts.explanation: The picture shows smoke above the recycling plant, so answer: Yes, there is.
